disclosures: Session 6aebc080ee4ea49332eb9b9d (opened via UI, received the first successful post-fix UI movement 6aebc084ee4ea49332eb9b9e, +150) was closed by the harness leftover handler with counted 500 instead of 650 (final discrepancy -150) because a page-context read-back returned a stale empty movement list. Harness error, not a product defect; the session remains as a closed domain record (the cash API has no session delete route).
Probe session 6aebb9cf21ad66aa3cc4fdc2 and leftover session 6aebbc4121ad66aa3cc4fdc3 were closed through the UI with counted = expected, discrepancy 0.

The canonical acceptance session is 6aebc0d8ee4ea49332eb9b9f: opened via UI (500), movement 6aebc0dcee4ea49332eb9ba0 via UI (+150, marker GA-CLICKFLOW-1793835221375), closed via UI with counted 650, expected 650, discrepancy 0.

While a session is open, the API/rendered session shows Expected as undefined (em dash); expected/counted/discrepancy materialize at close. This is current product behavior, recorded as an observation.

Transfer: the Transfer dialog rendered with no destination select/options because only one session is open; the open-session dialog hardcodes account Cash (CashJournal saveSession) and the UI exposes no way to open a second (e.g. Bank) account session, so a UI-level transfer between two open accounts is not possible in the current UI. Backend transfer behavior remains covered by the P0 API suites.

defectsFoundAndFixed.detail: Backend signin/socialSignin responses omitted user.type (and supplier). The admin SPA stores the sign-in response verbatim as the current user, so user.type was undefined after sign-in: CashJournal computed isAdmin=false, hid the agency selector, and sent cash mutations without the agency selector (open 403 / movement 400 Invalid cash movement / close 400). Fix: backend/src/controllers/userController.ts adds type + supplier to both loggedUser payloads. Verified: fresh sign-in returns type=admin; full UI flow then passes. Backend rebuilt (P0 build) and the compiled controller deployed into the running container; a desktop docker compose build reproduces it from source.

CashJournal vehicleName() crashed on maintenance expenses whose car resolves to null, failing the whole journal load. Fix: vehicleName accepts null/undefined and renders an em dash. Verified: orphan expense row renders; admin lint 0; build green.
